description: This file defines the interface for a socket adaptor class used for managing Unix domain socket connections, including methods for connecting, listening, reading, writing, and handling data and callbacks.

classes.name: socket_adaptor
classes.description: A class managing Unix domain socket connections, including connection setup, data transfer, and callback registration.

methods.name: connect_socket
methods.description: Connects to a specified socket path for reading data.

methods.name: start_listening
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming Unix domain socket connections on a specified path.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Returns the data path of the Unix domain socket server.

methods.name: fetch_data
methods.description: Reads all data from the socket into an internal buffer.

methods.name: get_active_connections
methods.description: Returns the number of active socket connections.

methods.name: register_data_ready_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked when data is ready.
